svg.title: KRONOS2 marker-aware tokens become one frozen patch embedding
svg.desc: A complete rectangular C-channel image patch is sampled at selected physical pixel size p and normalized with per-marker divisor, package mean and standard deviation. The same 16 by 16 stride-16 projection maps every channel to 256 tokens of width 768. Spatial position and compositional marker identity are added to image tokens. Marker identity combines the saved 1024-dimensional text vector with learned compartment and family embeddings. CLS receives its own positional term; CLS and all sixteen registers receive the first selected marker identity. CLS and registers precede the image tokens, giving 256C plus 17 tokens. Twelve frozen ViT-B transformer blocks have twelve attention heads, pre-normalization, LayerScale residual branches and a 768 to 3072 to 768 GELU MLP. Final normalization and CLS selection yield one 768-value embedding. Image planes, token values, attention patterns and weights are schematic, not measured activations.
